Pool service was severely lacking until we tipped them. We ate 1 night at Tipanier and the service was really bad, took 15 minutes to take our order, food overcooked. A nearby table vaped and played videos loudly and no server said anything. We ran out of TP, lotion and gel. We ordered room service and asked for no bacon on the salads and they both came with bacon. A manager was supposed to reach out after we complained but we never heard a thing. We are platinum at Marriott and just expect better service and food.

hotel: The Westin Bora Bora Resort & Spa
review_text: This is a lovely resort! Service was top notch. They upgraded us to a bungalow with a plunge pool. My only complaint about this property were the prices - food and drinks were expensive! A pizza and two beers delivered to the room ended up being close to $100 (includes a $14 delivery fee). A vodka soda at the pool bar was $35. Food entrees ranged $32-$56. Breakfast buffet was $50pp and just 'okay' - Eggs Benedict wasn't on the buffet, would be an extra $35. There is also a daily resort fee of $110. This resort is only a year old; I wish I had realized it's only a sandy bottom around the bungalows - saw a shark and a turtle but that was it from the deck. The concierge-booked snorkel trip was gorgeous though, saw huge manta rays and a coral garden.
review_title: Wonderful resort but everything is pricey!

hotel: The Westin Bora Bora Resort & Spa
review_text: My husband and I stayed at the Westin in Bora Bora and it was the BEST choice out of all the resorts! PROS: recently remodeled, great mountain view option, amazing customer service (shout out to Thierry & Varua), updated facilities, 24 hour front desk, multiple restaurant options. CONS: nothing, it was literally perfect, actually just some of the bikes needed extra love but perfect otherwise. We stayed in an overwater bungalow with a pool facing the mountain. They clean the salt pool every 2 days. A lot of people signed up for tours with the hotel, however I found Viator was much better pricing wise or even contacting the activity company directly - we used 'Bora Bora Activities Center', it's literally the same company the hotel used.

hotel: The Westin Bora Bora Resort & Spa
review_text: All we can say is 'WOW'...that trip exceeds expectations. The resort and staff were amazing, so friendly and willing to go the extra mile. Alan at the pool bar was so helpful, friendly, and made our guest experience unforgettable! Julianna made amazing drinks! The bungalow was an 11 out of 10, we definitely plan to come back!
review_title: Bora Amazing Bora at The Westin

hotel: The Westin Bora Bora Resort & Spa
review_text: I recently stayed at the Westin Bora Bora and left regretting my decision. The major 'gotcha' is your luck of the draw with which water bungalow you get - could be gorgeous views with a plunge pool or a view of the trash/freight shipment pickup area with huge blue crates and boats constantly transporting ugly boxes. The bungalow designers placed high privacy fencing ON PURPOSE on certain bungalows that blocks the gorgeous Mt. Otemanu view. I felt angry just being in the bungalow I was staying in and would have much rather forked over money for a better one, which is what Westin wants - it gives the entire resort a stingy 'pay to play' vibe, carried over in costs for every amenity ($160+ for a 30 minute jet ski tour, $150+ per meal for two). Room service ALWAYS resets your furniture arrangement back to face the trash site if you try to rearrange it to catch a mountain view. This is a Westin that feels artificial and sterile in many parts with fake-looking Disneyland-blue lagoons. You may have to contend with families taking over the pool and loud/rowdy guests.
review_title: Bad Bungalow = Bad Experience Basically (and a lot of them are bad!)

hotel: The Westin Bora Bora Resort & Spa
review_text: Average but not recommended. Lots of small things added up to a subpar overall experience. The service is really lacking for an upscale resort - servers are friendly but everyone continues to apologize that things are slow. It took 15 minutes just to get a water or glass of ice even though I was generous with tips, which shouldn't be necessary to get basic service. The rooms are fine as long as you don't want privacy - walls aren't high enough to shield you from the kids next door doing cannonballs at 7am off their deck, and your neighbors can also see you in your plunge pool. Just not worth what you pay no matter the deal. I'm lifetime platinum and this just didn't cut it. Food isn't great either.

hotel: The Westin Bora Bora Resort & Spa
review_text: The staff is very kind. Marvin welcomed us in a friendly and professional way. However, an unpleasant experience at restaurant Varavara - the waiter Baptiste took our order in a rude manner. Too bad!

hotel: The Westin Bora Bora Resort & Spa
review_text: I really enjoyed the new modern overwater bungalows in beautiful Bora Bora. The gym and spa are fantastic facilities. The only downside is the variety of food but I understand it can be hard if you're in the middle of the South Pacific. Also the Bluetooth speaker system built into the bungalow was awesome.
review_title: New modern bungalows in beautiful Bora Bora

hotel: The Westin Bora Bora Resort & Spa
review_text: Wonderful newly renovated resort - rooms were modern and clean and we had a gorgeous view of Mt. Otemanu from our plunge pool. The weather didn't cooperate, but we couldn't have been in a better place. Breakfast buffet was delicious with plenty of options and bakery fresh croissants. Loved that they take your egg orders at your table instead of forming a queue by the egg station.

hotel: The Westin Bora Bora Resort & Spa
review_text: We had an incredible stay at the Westin Bora Bora for our honeymoon. Newly renovated so everything is very clean, well taken care of, grounds beautifully maintained. Our overwater bungalow with its own pool offered amazing views of the main island. What really made the trip special were the pool guys - Alan, John, and Teamo. Unbelievably attentive, always had drinks ready, helped us get cabanas, gave great recommendations on restaurants and excursions.
review_title: Great Experience at the Westin (Special Thanks to the Pool Guys)

hotel: The Westin Bora Bora Resort & Spa
review_text: One of the best locations in Bora Bora. Outstanding property with a spectacular infinity pool. Multiple beaches and really good food, with very helpful, friendly staff. On the negative side, they need to get the check-in process better - this was my sixth trip to Bora Bora and every other resort has dedicated check-in staff for each guest so nobody waits; Westin only has 3 people checking you in and the rest of the guests wait, getting worse as more arrive. This is not acceptable for a resort like this. They also have bicycles to use around the property, but there are not enough and most of them have flat tires, broken wheels, no brakes, broken seats - really disappointing.

hotel: The Westin Bora Bora Resort & Spa
review_text: My fiancée and I got engaged during our stay at the Westin Bora Bora and although the resort was beautiful we were not super impressed with the service. The service sometimes felt disorganized, slow, and inconsistent EXCEPT the outstanding service from Teamo, Alan, and Blandine. Our experience with the concierge, particularly Zoe, was disappointing - rude, dismissive, every request met with eye-rolling and reluctance to help. As a Platinum Elite Marriott Bonvoy member I mentioned I was planning to propose during our stay - we were not given any upgrade or complimentary gifts celebrating our engagement. We arrived at 10am and our standard room wasn't available until 4:30pm, past the guaranteed check-in time. Beautiful resort but outside of the pool area, everything seemed disorganized - daily activities, restaurant staff, and concierge.
review_title: Best hard product in Bora Bora. Some phenomenal staff, but also some unfriendly/rude staff

hotel: The Westin Bora Bora Resort & Spa
review_text: Our stay at The Westin Bora Bora was absolutely wonderful! The location and views are breathtaking. The whole team made us feel so welcome, especially Lois/Loic who went above and beyond to make sure our check-in was smooth and helped with great local tips.

hotel: The Westin Bora Bora Resort & Spa
review_text: We stayed at the Westin for 4 nights for our honeymoon, simply a daydream. We arrived from the Moorea Sofitel resort, but there is really no comparison. The only flaw is the table service for breakfast in one of the three restaurants - really slow. But for what you pay you expect a 5 star service even at breakfast.

hotel: The Westin Bora Bora Resort & Spa
review_text: Just stayed 4 nights in October with 2 other couples and this is by far the best resort on Bora Bora right now when it comes to the updated rooms and resort overall - others may have advantages in customer service but are dated in rooms and decor. No reason not to get an overwater bungalow here. Never had a problem getting chairs at the pool or beach, never too crowded. Not much snorkeling here to do because there isn't much to see - leave that for excursions.
review_title: Updated Resort is an Updated Delight!

hotel: The Westin Bora Bora Resort & Spa
review_text: The Westin is a luxury resort set on a motu with views of Mt. Otemanu. A paradise, though costly - my room, with no meals included, for one night cost more than my entire three night stay at Huahine including three dinners, a massage, a land tour, and airport transfers. My overwater bungalow was spacious and very comfortable with a huge walk-in closet and a window in the floor. On my last full day I had a 90-minute massage, soothing with hot stones and verbena oil. A major attraction is their Eco Center where they rehabilitate injured sea turtles. My biggest complaint was the slow service at breakfast. Otherwise, I enjoyed my stay here very much.

hotel: The Westin Bora Bora Resort & Spa
review_text: The Westin Bora Bora is absolutely perfect - there's really no other word for it. The views are stunning, the water is crystal clear, every part of the resort is spotless. What truly made this trip unforgettable was the people - Alan, John, Nuiti, Varua, Tom, Rachel, Teamo, and Thierry were all incredible, going above and beyond to make sure our stay was everything we hoped for.

hotel: The Westin Bora Bora Resort & Spa
review_text: My wife and I chose The Westin for our honeymoon and it exceeded every dream we had. Our overwater villa was straight out of a postcard. Special recognition to Alan, our pool service attendant, who made our stay incredibly personal and enjoyable, going above and beyond every day. If you're thinking about booking a stay here, especially for a honeymoon, don't hesitate.

hotel: The Westin Bora Bora Resort & Spa
review_text: Gorgeous resort! Views are breathtaking and the overwater bungalows are special. Service is next level - we had great servers that somehow remembered our names. Alan and Teamo took such great care of us at the pool. Definitely a 5 star experience!

hotel: The Westin Bora Bora Resort & Spa
review_text: From the moment I checked in until the moment I departed, it was a magical experience. The views are beautiful beyond words and the staff could not have been better - Maelis in reception and all of the concierges were exceptional. This was my third time in Bora Bora and this was the best out of all 3 visits. My only regret was leaving.

hotel: The Westin Bora Bora Resort & Spa
review_text: We had an unforgettable stay for our honeymoon! The bungalows were impeccable and clean. The maintenance staff was also very friendly and attentive. A big thank you to Maëlis, who was very caring for us from our arrival.

hotel: The Westin Bora Bora Resort & Spa
review_text: Our honeymoon stay was absolutely unforgettable. The service was exceptional - Alan and Arthur went above and beyond to make every detail perfect. The grounds were stunning and the most modern of any other Bora Bora resort.

hotel: The Westin Bora Bora Resort & Spa
review_text: My wife and I shared part of our honeymoon at the Westin. The staff were incredibly friendly, welcoming and helpful. Our room was an overwater villa looking at Mount Otemanu with glass paneling on the floor to look at fish. The food at the resort was amazing, we dined at all the restaurants including Maere which did not disappoint.

hotel: The Westin Bora Bora Resort & Spa
review_text: Unforgettable stay at the Westin Bora Bora! The setting is beautiful and the service exceptional. Many thanks to Alan for his professionalism, kindness and constant attention.

hotel: The Westin Bora Bora Resort & Spa
review_text: The newly renovated Westin Bora Bora is undeniably stunning, fresh and modern with breathtaking views. That said, while the physical setting is five star, the service doesn't quite match - communication can be inconsistent, and the staff, while polite, don't seem empowered to go above and beyond. We stayed to celebrate my 40th birthday and the resort doesn't make much effort to acknowledge celebrations without being reminded, despite having asked beforehand if we were celebrating something. Our nightly upgrade awards didn't clear before arrival and there were no complimentary upgrades at check-in as a Marriott Platinum member. Having stayed at the St. Regis Bora Bora and the InterContinental, those resorts might be a better choice for more personalized and attentive service - the Westin is ideal for travelers who value scenery and comfort over attentive service.

hotel: The Westin Bora Bora Resort & Spa
review_text: We loved the Westin Bora Bora and our honeymoon was magical! Pros: brand new and stunning resort, nice amenities like Bluetooth speakers, super nice breakfast buffet, delicious dinner restaurants (had the vegetarian menu at Maere and it was really good), enjoyed the free events like paddleboarding, lei making, wine tasting, Tahitian dance class. Cons: the pool boys don't actually inflate innertubes, just hand you an ineffectual hand pump; not good snorkeling onsite, don't expect coral around the resort; often out of food items like the mushroom pizza and the Oreo shake (tried to order it on 3 separate days and never got to try it).

hotel: The Westin Bora Bora Resort & Spa
review_text: Beautiful location with views of Mount Otemanu. The overwater rooms are super cool, diving right off the balconies into the ocean is very memorable. You are treated like a king here, total royalty treatment, feels like you're in an episode of the White Lotus. Great deal for points redemption. Very clean and quiet.

hotel: The Westin Bora Bora Resort & Spa
review_text: This resort is beautiful, very new so everything is in good condition. The food is mediocre and overpriced - I would suggest bringing wine and snacks to enjoy at your bungalow. The staff is really friendly and claim to do whatever it takes, but we found that about half the time, they wouldn't do what they said they were going to do. Most problems were solved by the 3rd call, but that seems like a lot. There isn't really off-shore snorkeling at the resort - a few rays swim by, but no coral and very few pretty fish. The staff discourages guests from eating dinner on the main island where you can get a much better meal - it felt like they were more concerned with us spending our money at the resort than having the best possible experience. We booked the pure snorkeling activity through them and it was excellent, the highlight of our stay.

hotel: The Westin Bora Bora Resort & Spa
review_text: Arriving into the Bora Bora airport we were greeted by resort staff offering a lei. We had a large bathroom with mirrors that slid open for a full view of the room looking into the lagoon. The plunge pool was a great amenity we used every day. We got the breakfast and dinner meal package - Varavara was our go-to for dinner, Maere is the upscale fixed menu restaurant, ate there twice during our 2 week stay. The resort gym has treadmills, stair climber, rowing machines and dumbbells up to 22kg. On site they have a turtle sanctuary with 3 turtles getting nursed back to health.
review_title: The trip of a lifetime!! What Beauty!!
